subject: Attestation witness scheduling, SIG evidence intake & ticketing plan
messages:
From: Procurement - Tessera Health <procurement@tesserahealth.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire + SOC2 witness schedule request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this on. Tessera is finalizing vendor evaluation next week and we need two things from Redwood: (1) a completed SIG questionnaire (we attached the vendor form) and (2) SOC 2 remote witness availability for a short auditor interview and review of controls.

Key constraints: our procurement window closes 09/24. Auditor will need the attestation PDF and a 30–45 minute remote witness slot (PST morning preferred). We also prefer that evidence is uploaded into a ticketed system so our QA team can track artifacts (CSV exports / timestamps required).

Attached: Tessera_SIG_Vendor_Form.docx (please complete and return)

Can you confirm who will be the control owners and whether Redwood can accept uploads to your secure folder or if Tessera should provide a SFTP link?

Thanks,
Procurement
Tessera Health

Hi -- thanks, received. Quick plan and owners: 

- Jasmine Liu (jasmine.liu@redwood.ai) will own completing the SIG control mapping and will return the completed form and a crosswalk to our SOC 2 controls.
- Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.ai) will own evidence collection and packaging; he will create a ticketed intake for each artifact.
- Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.ai) will coordinate the auditor witness logistics and secure upload link.

We can support remote witness sessions and provide the SOC 2 attestation PDF. Proposed auditor windows (PST mornings): 09/20, 09/21, 09/22 (09:00-11:30). Please confirm which date/time works for your audit team.

We prefer Tessera upload artifacts to our secure shared Drive folder (link below) but can accept SFTP if that is required by your procurement team. Action items we will deliver by 09/18: completed SIG form, control crosswalk (Excel), evidence manifest, SOC2 attestation PDF.

Secure upload link (read-only until we add you): https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/tessera-upload/ABC123

Karthik

Karthik / team — I started the SIG crosswalk. Summary below and specific asks for Tessera: 

- Completed control mapping: column A = SIG item, column B = Redwood control reference (SOC 2 section + internal policy), column C = artifact required, column D = owner.
- Immediate asks for Tessera (please ask procurement/legal): 
  * Access logs: we will provide a redacted access-log extract covering 2025-10 to 2026-08 (CSV) for privileged admin activity. Please confirm acceptable redaction level.
  * Change control evidence: PR/merge history links and release notes for the last 6 months (we can provide a PDF export).
  * Data residency confirmation: signed regional data processing addendum (if required).

I attached a draft control_map_draft.xlsx — it's internal but shows the shape of what we'll upload. Ben, please create the ticket items and include the artifact filename convention (redwood_prod-<control>-YYYYMMDD.zip).
